quick.topic: Together is not the same as cause
quick.summary: Two numbers rising together doesn’t mean one causes the other. Here’s how to tell.
quick.takeaway: Moving together is not causing. Find the hidden cause, then test.

beats.line: Ice cream sales go up, and so does sunburn. Should we ban ice cream?
Good question. Let us look before we ban anything.
Here is June, July and August.
Sunburn climbs in the very same months.
They move together. So one causes the other?
That is the trap. Moving together is not causing.
Then why do they rise at the same time?
Because something else is pushing both of them.
Something else? What is it?

parts.title: The hidden third thing
parts.cliff: So how do you prove what causes what?

beats.line: So what pushes ice cream and sunburn up together?
The sun. Hot days sell ice cream.
Hot days also put people outside, in the sun.
So the weather causes both. Ice cream did nothing wrong.
Exactly. Analysts call the sun a confounding factor.
Can I just say the hidden cause?
Yes. The hidden cause behind both.
Then every chart could be hiding one.
Many do. So you have to test it.
Test it how?
How do I prove one thing causes another?
Change one thing, and keep everything else the same.
Take two groups of customers. Same kind of people.
Group B gets the new button. Group A does not.
And if group B buys more?
Then the button did it. Nothing else was different.
What if I cannot run a test?
Then say it moves with sales. Not that it causes sales.
Moves with is honest. Causes needs a test.
That one sentence will save you a lot of bad calls.

quiz.question: Stores with more staff have higher sales. What is the safest reading?
options: They move together. A test would show whether staff cause sales.
There is no link at all.
quiz.explanation: Bigger stores may simply have both. Only changing staffing on its own would show the cause.

quiz.question: If two numbers rise together, one of them must be causing the other.
quiz.explanation: A hidden third thing can push both, the way hot weather lifts ice cream sales and sunburns.
